acceptanceCriteria.description: The Product Map tab renders every bucket collapsed by default, with a summary row carrying the bucket label, its total REQ count and a mini count per authoring status (draft / review / needsRevision / approved / superseded). A jump-nav rail across the top of the panel lists every bucket in the active grouping with its count; clicking a chip scrolls to that bucket and opens it. The hash schema `#tab=product-map&group=<g>&status=<s>&open=<id1>,<id2>` restores tab, grouping, status filter AND the set of open buckets on return, and every bucket-toggle pushes a new history entry so Back/Forward traverse them. Per-bucket <details> nodes carry a stable data-doc-id ("pm-bucket:<group>:<id>") so the live-client persists their open state across SSE refreshes.
